lines.text: Many learners say: I want a coffee, please.
Better: I would like a coffee, please.
Would like sounds nicer when you order.
I would like! I would like a coffee, please.

data.right: I would like a coffee, please.
data.why: Would like sounds nicer when you order.
data.memory: I would like a coffee, please.

native.hook: 注文で「I want」は強すぎる？
native.tip: お店では I would like ... が丁寧。I want は少し直接的です。
native.caption: “I want a coffee, please.”と言っていませんか？😅 「〜がほしい」をそのまま want にすると、ぶっきらぼうに聞こえることがあります。“I would like a coffee, please.” が自然な言い方です。Amaの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“I would like”。“I would like a coffee, please.” を声に出して言ってみよう。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.tip: In shops, say I would like for a polite tone.
en.caption: Do you say this? “I want a coffee, please.” 😅 Want can sound a little strong when you ask for something. The natural way is “I would like a coffee, please.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
